description: "Use when making user-visible repository changes. Enforces updating CHANGELOG.md in the same change set and keeping the existing changelog style."
name: "Changelog Update Requirement"
applyTo: "**"
---
# Changelog Update Requirement

- Update CHANGELOG.md whenever a change is user-visible.
- Keep changelog entries concise and user-facing.
- Follow the existing repository changelog style.
- For internal-only changes, CHANGELOG.md can be skipped.
